metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy psoas muscle release you can do at home. 

This exercise is especially good for aches and pains across the top of your thigh and hip. It can be done at home (or work), requires no special equipment, and may give tightness and pain relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
